policy: A named test is evidence of intent, not proof of a current result. Import TRX output from a recorded local or CI run; results retain run provenance and never overwrite the capability contract.
stalenessPolicy: A result from a different git revision is historical evidence only; it cannot satisfy a current strict-promotion review.
resultDiscoveryNote: Discovery MUST cover where the suites actually write. Until 2026-09-04 it listed only TestResults/**/*.trx, which holds the 10 hand-curated registry runs (162 tests) — while a full-suite run writes 40 TRX files and >12,000 results into logs/full-suite_*/. The registry therefore reported 7 of 964 modes as having a passing recorded contract while the suite was passing 10,332 tests. That was a plumbing defect being read as an evidence deficit.
